name: Collins Sheet Metal Inc.

We work with metals varying in thickness from 26 gauge to 1/2 inch. A few of our jobs have even required 1 inch! Custom metal fabrication, duct systems, machine guarding, hoods, dust collection systems, stairways, railings, bending, shearing, welding, plasma cutting, steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper work, flashings, pans and more. about:
Collins Sheet Metal, Inc. has operated from Berwick, Maine since 1985. The family-owned business was started by Gary Collins Sr. in a home garage and has since expanded to a 10,000-square-foot facility.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication including duct systems, machine guarding, hoods, dust collection, stairways, railings, and architectural metalwork. Processes cover bending, shearing, welding, plasma cutting, CNC machining, waterjet cutting, laser cutting, punching, and finishing. Materials range from 26-gauge to 1/2-inch thick steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and copper, with occasional 1-inch jobs.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company built its reputation on custom residential ductwork, which still accounts for 70–90% of installed ductwork made in-house. Industrial projects include an aviation platform for a local airport, machine guarding with manual rising shields, burner chambers for automotive hot-air molding, kitchen exhaust hoods, stainless steel diverting chutes, portable holding tanks, restaurant shelving, and backsplashes.

Collins emphasizes fair pricing, a one-year warranty on parts and labor, and satisfaction guaranteed. The team focuses on problem-solving, turning customer drawings into finished products on time and on budget.
